name: Black saxaul
desc: A tough desert shrub or small tree of loose sand. In the Gobi it is often the only tree, and its roots help hold dunes in place.
about: Haloxylon ammodendron, variously called the saxaul (Russian: саксау́л, romanized: saksaúl), black saxaul, also spelled sacsaoul or saksaul is a plant belonging to the family Amaranthaceae.
